description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot using Pipecat framework, integrating speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and language model services, with custom transport configurations and event handlers.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline instance with parameters and timeout.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Maintains context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs user and assistant aggregators with context.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Configuration for WebSocket transport via FastAPI.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the bot.
